title: Building This Portfolio
body:
This is the first entry in the log — a portfolio built as a system launcher rather than a traditional resume site: a horizontal HUD carousel for navigation, pages that pop straight out of the button you click, and three themes (dark, light, and a Windows 11-flavored one with blue and pink accents) that swap without touching a single component's code.

Everything on the About and Projects pages is sourced live from plain Markdown files at the repo root instead of being hardcoded into components, so updating a resume detail or shipping a new project is a one-line edit away from showing up here. Daiky, the assistant page, wires up chat, voice input, and file staging entirely client-side — no model or backend behind it yet, that comes next.

This Articles page is the newest addition: a JSON-driven log for anything worth writing down — projects shipped, events attended, sketches finished, or tech worth raving about. Adding a new one is just a new entry in a JSON file, photos and all.
